name: flow-mcp
description: Build, run, publish Eureka Flow visual workflows and manage credits from Claude — no code.
long_description: Eureka Flow MCP server. Lets Claude (and other MCP clients) create visual workflows, run them, publish them publicly, and manage billing credits at flow.eureka.codes / billing.eureka.codes — all in natural language. One API key unlocks both flows and credits.

api_key.title: Eureka API Key
api_key.description: Get it free: open https://flow.eureka.codes → sign in with Google → Create Key → Copy. The key looks like "ec-..." and is shown only once. Unlocks both flows and credits.

tools.name: flow_run
tools.description: Run a workflow with real-time monitoring

tools.name: credit_purchase
tools.description: Top up credits with the card on file
